entities.summary: Article 5: "No one shall be subjected to torture or to cruel, inhuman or degrading treatment or punishment." Drafted after the Holocaust, the UDHR established that some punishments violate human dignity regardless of the crime. It is the foundation of all modern anti-torture law.
